tools.name: verify_record
tools.description:
Checks whether a signed document, an agreement, a receipt or a Share proof is genuine, and what it says.
It runs the same public check anyone can run at attest.datahubz.com/verify, with no account.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "verify" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_record · Private data: verify_record · Public sink: verify_record · Destructive: verify_record.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_record · Private data: verify_record · Public sink: verify_record · Destructive: verify_record

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
